description: This Java file defines a data transfer object (LoanPenaltyData) for encapsulating penalty-related financial data in a loan management context. It also includes a MapStruct mapper interface for converting a LoanSummary domain object into this data object, facilitating data transformation and mapping.

classes.name: LoanPenaltyData
classes.description: A data class holding penalty charge amounts related to a loan.

classes.name: LoanPenaltyData.Mapper
classes.description: A MapStruct mapper interface for converting LoanSummary objects into LoanPenaltyData instances.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Maps a LoanSummary domain object to a LoanPenaltyData DTO, translating specific fields as defined by the MapStruct annotations.
